svg.title: Application domains
svg.desc: 2×2 rounded cards: sign language and news research in the first row; instrument performance and makeup tutorials in the second. Examples support training dataset construction and research.

text.font-family: Segoe UI Emoji, Apple Color Emoji, sans-serif

g.text: Sign language
Major datasets · Validated application
Sign-language videos were collected from three manually
selected YouTube channels.
Human annotators reviewed candidate videos and could
apply a label to the entire channel.
The author randomly sampled videos from each channel
before accepting, rejecting, or investigating it.

text.font-family: Segoe UI Emoji, Apple Color Emoji, sans-serif

g.text: News & communication research
Channel selection also supports sampling and analysis
Humans examined 17,797 channels and retained 377
news/current-affairs channels, using titles and thumbnails of
the latest 15 videos.
For channel characteristics, content, and communication
The first author reviewed 10 random videos per channel,
removing inactive or non-US-news/politics channels. The final
dataset has 973 channels, not the initial screening pool.
For cross-partisan commenting and audience overlap
After keyword, follower-count, and organization-name filters,
all remaining 3,576 YouTube accounts were manually
reviewed.
For news creators, content production, and communication

text.font-family: Segoe UI Emoji, Apple Color Emoji, sans-serif

g.text: Instrument performance
Major dataset · Potential extension
Piano performances were collected from 23 selected channels
known for piano content.
Selecting consistent performance channels provides a
starting point for music dataset construction.
After preprocessing, PIAST mainly provides audio,
transcribed MIDI, and text.

text.font-family: Segoe UI Emoji, Apple Color Emoji, sans-serif

g.text: Makeup tutorials
Major dataset · Potential extension
Researchers first compiled brands and beauty bloggers, then
found their official channels and collected tutorials.
Channel screening narrows a broad creator community to
relevant instructional sources.
Jev Account Filter can select accounts by tutorial content
and creator focus.
